not.tr: Boş bir ev, boş bir arazi. Yine de biri var gibi.
not.en: An empty house, an empty field. And yet someone seems to be there.
not.fr: Une maison vide, un champ vide. Et pourtant quelqu’un semble là.

kaynak_kredisi: George Inness, “The Lonely Farm, Nantucket”, 1892 · Art Institute of Chicago, kamu malı
